# Salman Yousufzai

Offers SEO services (technical, on-page, off-page, local SEO, and GEO/AEO for AI search), blog and content writing, and web development with SEO (clean HTML websites and WordPress/Elementor pages). Works remotely with clients in the United States and worldwide.
